Dr. Martinez, patient Maria Chen (age 34) presents with: Recurrent sinusitis, 6 episodes in 12 months, failed two courses of antibiotics. Relevant history: Allergic rhinitis (diagnosed age 12); Deviated nasal septum (CT confirmed 2025-11); No surgical history. Current medications: Fluticasone nasal spray, Cetirizine 10mg daily.

Based on the clinical presentation, a referral to ENT appears indicated. Coordinate with the care team: have the specialist evaluate, pharmacist review current medications for any concerns with the transition, insurance verify coverage, and nurse schedule the appointment once approved.

Clinical calibration instructions: Attending should call request_referral with the patient_id and specialty. Insurance and nurse may complete preauth and scheduling, but the calibration success check requires the referral to be tool-recorded. Stop once the referral is submitted.

I'm referring Maria Chen (PT-20461) for ENT evaluation. She has recurrent sinusitis (6 episodes/12 months) with CT-confirmed deviated septum and failed medical management. Please review and confirm acceptance. I'll coordinate with insurance for pre-auth and nurse for scheduling once you confirm.

ENT referral for Maria Chen (PT-20461) is now active (REF-3389ABDB). Clinical indication: recurrent sinusitis with 6 episodes in 12 months, failed medical management including two antibiotic courses and optimized intranasal steroid/antihistamine therapy, plus CT-confirmed anatomical obstruction (deviated septum). Please confirm acceptance so insurance can process pre-auth and scheduling can proceed.

ENT referral REF-3389ABDB for Maria Chen (PT-20461) accepted. Clinical indication confirmed: recurrent acute sinusitis (6 episodes/12 months) on optimized medical therapy with anatomical obstruction. Failed conservative management meets criteria for surgical evaluation. Recommend in-office endoscopy and discuss potential septoplasty/FESS pending exam findings.
